reviews.title: A worthwhile investment
reviews.comment: I'm very happy with my purchase. Solid upgrade for the price. Be sure to have an adequate power supply of 700w or better. Also, because it's an ASUS, it'll last me a good long while.
reviews.author: Javier Sanchez
